messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t identify other customers or say whether your neighbour returned theirs. I can see that your garden hose reel was received back and hasn’t been refunded yet. Would you like to request a refund for it?
